trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so treat it as a progress marker rather than a task: work the roadmap in order (story, then the 100% checklist, then strangers and cleanup) and this one follows on its own. The whole list is single-player, so no multiplayer or DLC is needed for it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is the first thing you play. Finish it and the trophy is yours — it cannot be missed and needs no preparation. It is the game handing you the keys to Leonida.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes, so there is nothing extra to do — just keep following the story. If you are chasing the one missable meditation (Positive Mental Attitude), do it before this chapter ends, because its first spot disappears with the chapter.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic and unmissable — it lands when the chapter's final mission is done. By now both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens up the partner activities.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic on chapter completion. The robbery trophies (bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations) start opening up around this point in the story, so keep an eye out for them as you play.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Automatic when the chapter closes. You are deep into the late game now — the remaining story trophies are the final mission and the contact finales.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. It unlocks when the credits roll. Make a manual save before starting it — there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so guides recommend a save at the start of every chapter and one before the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it unlocks automatically when you finish it — not missable, no extra condition. Just play the story.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission, automatic on completion. Heist missions are the big set-pieces — finish the job and the trophy follows.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission, automatic. Keep playing the story and it will come.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission, automatic on completion.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story mission, automatic. The airport setting is also where the unscheduled-departure trophy (Catch Me If You Can) lives, so remember the area for later.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission, automatic on completion.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which only opens after the story. The thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion: about 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, and 300 stunts. Most of it comes free from chasing the other trophies; the checklist itself is the grind. It is the hardest trophy on the list, and the whole platinum runs about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights, base jumps. There are 397 stunts in total, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so you will pass 250 naturally on the way to 100%. The in-game stunt counter tracks your progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The nine are the game's side activities — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone races and the rest. Sample one of each and it pops. You do not need to win or master any of them, just try them.

source.name: GGRecon — GTA 6 trophies and achievements list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is one of the few tasks the 100% checklist requires in full, so it is worth practicing early. Learn each range's layout, then chase gold one challenge at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are also required in full for the 100% checklist. Learn the course at each spot, then win it — the trophy counts locations, so every one of the 14 must be won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but they must be 20 distinct races — replaying the same one does not add to the count. Work through the race list across Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him in the challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick a machine, and play it through to the end. Any arcade game counts — finish one and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand runs through the story; finish his last mission and the trophy unlocks. Side-character finales are automatic once you reach them.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other contact finales — play Kenton's strand to its end.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand; the trophy lands on his last mission.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. These are the side questlines marked for strangers — 8 full strands. They are not part of the 100% checklist, so they are a Step 3 cleanup job, but you can start them as they appear. The guides are still confirming exactly which strands count, so check the source before you commit to a strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its last mission.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, with Lucia on the balcony, and it becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter. There is no mission replay, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. After that, work through the remaining 17 spots at your own pace.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are one of the tasks the 100% checklist requires in full, so find Bret, take the hunt, and bring down the unique animal he names. Study animals with the binoculars on the way — the checklist wants 100 of 255 studied.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a full set is a fixed group of cards, and you need three complete sets. Track your sets in the collectibles menu and sweep one region at a time.

source.name: GGRecon — GTA 6 trophies and achievements list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and tag activity — find the marked spots across the map and use it at 100 of them. It is a pure count, so keep tagging as you travel and the total climbs.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and the 100% checklist needs 70, so 50 comes first. Pick the easy ones — the checklist lets you skip the hardest 10 — and the trophy follows from normal play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. It needs both of you together, so do it once both characters are playable (Chapter 2 onward).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the heat the whole way — do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. Plan a route with three close shops and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game counts a vehicle as discovered when you scan it — the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277, so scan everything you pass. Work it during the story and it will be well advanced by the end.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until you have a group of enemies together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Crowded shootouts are the place to try it — you can retry as often as you like.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At the airport, find a way out that is not a scheduled flight — steal a plane or otherwise leave by an unofficial route. It is a one-off stunt at the airport, retryable in free roam.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank situation — find a Rhino (military areas, high wanted levels) and get hot in it. Retryable in free roam, so keep trying until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Plan the approach, avoid cameras and guards, and get out clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again; it is retryable.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies unlock in the later chapters (Chapters 3-4). Hit five vaults and get away clean each time — the count is cumulative, so you can do them one by one across free roam.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and get away. Trucks spawn in traffic — watch for them and strike when the road is clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The game tracks 52 areas — visit every one of them. The map fills in as you travel; use the checklist in this app to tick areas off, and mop up the stragglers in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs — hit one illegal operation per gang. Each gang's operations are in their territory; the count is one per gang, so nine robberies in total.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the early guides — check the source for the precise spot once it is pinned down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Find a vehicle showroom, get in a car, and smash out through the front in the style the name suggests. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the early guides — check the source for the precise setup.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the trophy is about the follow-through, so play a frame and see it through. Any game at that alley counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a partner moment — do something with your partner that the game reads as a crowd-pleaser. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the early guides; check the source for the precise moment once it is pinned down.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This tracks the choices you make across the game — keep making them and the count climbs over the whole run. It is a long grind, not a single moment, so just play and choose.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about the retry. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the early guides; check the source for the precise setup once it is pinned down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — a weird event out in the world. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the early guides; it is likely a random or one-off world event, so keep an eye out while you roam and check the source for the location once it is pinned down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive by in a vehicle and knock someone down with a melee attack. It is a drive-by with a melee weapon — line up a slow pass and swing. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the early guides; check the source for the precise setup.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts and the total climbs. It is cumulative — keep laundering as you rob and the $250,000 arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Just spend — clothes, weapons, food, anything in any shop. It is cumulative across the whole run, so normal shopping gets you most of the way; top it up at the end if needed.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida. Save up, buy them one by one, and the trophy pops on the last one. Property purchases also help the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them in the Scooter Bros app — 10 registrations in total. It pairs with Whip It Good (discovering vehicles), so register the ones you discover as you go.
